import ctypes

def gsl_min_test_interval(x_lower, x_upper, epsabs, epsrel):
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the function prototype
    gsl.gsl_min_test_interval.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_min_test_interval.restype = ctypes.c_int

    # Call the function and return the result
    return gsl.gsl_min_test_interval(x_lower, x_upper, epsabs, epsrel)

        assert gsl_min_test_interval(1.0, 2.0, 0.01, 0.01) == 1, "Test case 2 failed"
        assert gsl_min_test_interval(-1.0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.1) == 1, "Test case 3 failed"
        assert gsl_min_test_interval(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) == 0, "Test case 4 failed"
        assert gsl_min_test_interval(1.0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.1) == 0, "Test case 5 failed"
        print("All test cases passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(e)
